notes: MIGRATED on 2026-08-09, measured from the workshop machine after the migration was executed there: the three retired ids (specialists, specialists-shopify, specialists-ecomm) were uninstalled and replaced by team-alpha, team-shopify and team-ecomm, all project-scope v4.0.0 on commit d755a1d with payload present. Recorded here only after the consumer's own PR (BWJ-ecommerce/smartwatchbanden#259) had merged, per the rule below that this register records what a consumer HAS. Three things worth keeping from that migration. (1) The 'repo' field said davekokbwj/smartwatchbanden until this update while the real remote has been BWJ-ecommerce/smartwatchbanden -- a drift older than the migration and invisible to every check, because nothing here resolves the slug against GitHub; the localCheckout path is unrelated and stays correct, since the local folder genuinely is davekokbwj/. (2) team-ecomm was enabled in the consumer's settings.json but had never been registered here at all, so its three extensions (06-26/27/28) are added rather than renamed. (3) workflow-davekjohn is new and ships no agents/, hence the deliberately empty extension list -- an empty array is the measured answer, not an un-filled one. The migration also surfaced three inbound issues (#555 dead @-import and dead agent ids with no migration path, #556 new-changelog-entry.ps1 removed without a breaking-change notice, #557 the branch/ convention against a consumer CI gate on <branch>.md); the consumer is on the new ids but still resolves shared scripts through a stale 3.1.2 cache until #556 is answered. Kept from the 2026-07-29 entry, because both lessons still hold: the missing-Get-RosterIgnoredIds fingerprint is what misled the inbound #203 investigation -- that alarm was true and about THIS repo, but surfaced inside a life-hub session, which is why the checks now name the repo a finding is about. And the inventory is deliberately left un-pre-filled while lenses are still absent, because this register records what a consumer HAS: claiming a lens early makes the check report 'registered extension(s) missing', turning the register itself into a false alarm. Historical: the catch-up opened 2026-07-28 and closed 2026-07-29 with all 19 team-alpha extensions present; 06-23 (Sebastian, then named Sean) registered since swb commit 7dca9bd (2026-07-17). CAUGHT UP 2026-08-27 (#978): the workflow plugin's id moved from 'workflow-davekjohn@' to 'contributing-davekjohn@' (source issue #886, commit 8797f7a5) and this record held the retired name. Measured against their live .claude/settings.json (GitHub API): team-alpha@, team-shopify@, team-ecomm@ and contributing-davekjohn@, all four enabled, so they have migrated and this register had not. The sentences above keep the name they were WRITTEN with -- they are dated measurements, and rewriting one to match today's names is the defect #952 was made of. The empty extension list is unchanged and still the measured answer: that plugin ships no agents/. NOT MEASURED IN THIS PASS: the version drift and the 3.1.2 shared-script cache noted above -- this branch corrected the plugin ids and nothing else, so anything here about how far behind they are is as old as its own sentence. CORRECTED 2026-09-06 (#1524): localCheckout is now a LIST of relative candidates rather than one string, because the layout genuinely differs per machine and no single value is true on both. Measured on two machines, both holding both BWJ checkouts: on one the source checkout and a 'bwjecommerce' folder are siblings, giving ../../bwjecommerce/<repo>; on the other the source checkout sits one folder deeper, alongside a 'GitHub' folder that holds 'bwjecommerce', giving ../../GitHub/bwjecommerce/<repo>. The recorded '../../davekokbwj/<repo>' resolves on neither. WHY THIS IS ITS OWN DEFECT AND NOT A TYPO: a path that does not resolve is not reported as wrong, it is reported as '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' -- a sentence that ASSERTS an absence which was false, exits 0, and suppresses the entire connector block. On the machine #1524 was measured from, that one skip covered four [INFO] lines about retired plugin ids and a drift check reading 26 missing agent-defs, none of which the machine could see. The check now takes the first candidate present here and names all of them when none is, so a register stale about a machine's layout can be told from a checkout that is genuinely absent. NOT MEASURED: whether a third machine carries a third layout. The field is additive, so recording one is appending a string. The 2026-08-09 sentence above -- 'the localCheckout path is unrelated and stays correct, since the local folder genuinely is davekokbwj/' -- keeps its wording, because it is a dated measurement and rewriting one to match today's answer is the defect #952 was made of. It is simply no longer true: davekokbwj/ is on neither machine. CAUGHT UP 2026-09-06 (#1523): the 4.31.0 plugin renames moved the four ids this record held -- team-alpha@ -> dkj-team-alpha@, team-shopify@ -> dkj-team-shopify@, team-ecomm@ -> dkj-team-ecomm@, contributing-davekjohn@ -> dkj-policy@ -- and this record also never carried a fifth plugin the consumer now enables: dkj-policy-bwj@ (the BWJ workflow chapter, the id that was bwj-codex@ before the rename). Measured against the consumer's own origin/main after a fresh fetch, not a local working copy: .claude/settings.json at fcd54c4 (2026-09-06) enables dkj-team-alpha@, dkj-team-shopify@, dkj-team-ecomm@, dkj-policy@ and dkj-policy-bwj@, all five, so they have fully migrated and this register had not. dkj-policy-bwj@ ships no agents/ (skills/, templates/ and the portable docs only), so its extensions array is the measured answer and not an un-filled one -- the same answer as dkj-policy@. The extension inventories were re-counted against .claude/specialists/lenses/ on origin/main and match what is recorded (19 + 3 + 3); nothing else here was re-checked -- not the machine version, not the shared-script cache drift noted above -- this branch corrected the plugin ids and registered the fifth plugin, nothing more. WHAT THE RETIRED NAMES COST is the same shape connectors/xoxowildhearts.json and connectors/claude-code-specialists.json already recorded for the #886 and #1437 renames respectively: check-connectors reported an [INFO] for each of the four unresolvable ids and then SKIPPED every one of this consumer's plugin blocks, so all five of its plugins sat outside the version check -- four skipped as unresolvable, one never listed -- i.e. the consumer furthest ahead was the one the register could say least about, exactly as #1523 inferred without re-running it. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. CORRECTED 2026-09-07 (#1553): the 'repo' field named BWJ-ecommerce/smartwatchbanden, which is ARCHIVED. The live consumer is BWJ-Development/smartwatchbanden -- a fresh repo with the same content rather than a transfer, so there is no redirect behind the old name and nothing would have resolved it. Measured 2026-09-07 from this checkout: gh repo view BWJ-ecommerce/smartwatchbanden --json isArchived -> true (pushed 2026-09-07T09:18:59Z), and gh repo view BWJ-Development/smartwatchbanden --json isArchived -> false (pushed 2026-09-07T17:57:28Z) -- the live one was still being pushed to hours after the archived one stopped. WHY IT WAS INVISIBLE is the silent class the localCheckout correction above already records for a different field: nothing here resolves the slug against GitHub -- the 2026-08-09 sentence above says exactly that -- so a stale slug is never reported as wrong, it is simply never checked. WHAT IT DID AND DID NOT COST, which #1553 filed as its own explicitly unmeasured question and which is answered here rather than left open: this field is read as a LABEL and nowhere else. check-connectors.ps1 reads it for the == connector: header, for the connector label that disambiguates a two-consumer run, and as the value of checkedConsumers, which supplies the drift-check header and the finding scope -- all of them display. So the stale slug was bookkeeping that read wrong, not a check that read the archived repo, and this lands as a data correction rather than as a repair to the checker. HOW IT REACHED THIS REGISTER LATE: the move was raised in a comment on #1523 rather than as its own issue -- correct at the time, to avoid duplicating #1537 -- and that comment closed with #1523 once the plugin-id renames it was about were repaired, so nothing open carried it any more. NOT TOUCHED IN THIS PASS, deliberately: connectors/xoxowildhearts.json still names BWJ-ecommerce/xoxowildhearts, which is NOT archived and was pushed 2026-09-07T14:40:18Z, so that field is currently correct; a BWJ-Development/xoxowildhearts also exists (pushed 2026-09-07T13:18:54Z), so that store may be mid-move, and whether it is remains the open question on #1537. Nothing else here was re-checked -- not the machine version, not the shared-script cache drift noted above -- this branch corrected one field. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952. CORRECTED 2026-09-10 (#1807): APPENDED '../../davekokbwj/smartwatchbanden' rather than replacing a candidate. This is #1524 again one machine over, and it regressed rather than drifted because that repair wrote the 'davekokbwj/' candidate OUT and 'bwjecommerce/' IN -- in the very field it had just turned into a list so no machine's layout would have to be evicted. Measured 2026-09-10 on Dave's primary machine at source bef8914e: the checkout is at GitHub/davekokbwj/smartwatchbanden (its own project-scoped install record in ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json, so a live checkout and not a leftover), so '../../davekokbwj/smartwatchbanden' from the repo root resolves and neither bwjecommerce/ candidate does. Before this, check-connectors reported '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' -- a false absence that exits 0 and suppresses the whole connector block, exactly the class #1524 recorded. localCheckout is first-match and additive, so the two bwjecommerce/ candidates stay for the machines they are true on and this is a pure append. NOT ADDED: '../../bwjdevelopment/smartwatchbanden', which #1807 anticipated as a fourth entry -- that folder is not on this machine (GitHub/ holds DaveKJohn, davekokbwj and Others, nothing else), so recording it would be a guessed string in an additive field; add it when a machine actually lays the tree out that way. RECORDED NOT DECIDED, per #1807: first-match-wins cannot express two checkouts of the same repo under different parents on one machine -- the second is never checked and its install record goes stale unnoticed. Whether that warrants anything beyond first-match is a design call left open. NOT RE-MEASURED: the machine version, the shared-script cache drift, and the davekokbwj/smartwatchbanden checkout's own origin remote -- it points at BWJ-ecommerce/smartwatchbanden, the archived repo #1553 moved the 'repo' field away from, which is a stale remote in the consumer checkout rather than a field of this register. This branch appended one candidate and nothing else. MIGRATED 2026-09-11 (#1769), on flag day itself and after this consumer, exactly as decision A (Dave, 2026-09-10) prescribed: the register writes a renamed id only after the consumer itself has migrated. Measured in the consumer rather than taken from a plan: its .claude/settings.json on main names, after the merge, only <plugin>@dkj-claude-plugins and no @claude-code-specialists at all. The marketplace has been called dkj-claude-plugins since v5.0.0; there is NO redirect on a marketplace name the way there is on a repo slug, so the reinstall per machine and per checkout is what finishes this migration, and this register cannot see it. NOT MEASURED in this pass: the extension inventories, the machine versions and the drift figures -- all carried over unchanged. The sentences above keep the names they were written with, per #952. CORRECTED 2026-09-11 (#1831): APPENDED '../../bwj-development/smartwatchbanden' -- #1524/#1807 one machine further, and the third machine the #1807 note said to wait for. Measured 2026-09-11 on this machine (source checkout at Documents/Github/dkj-solutions/dkj-claude-plugins, commit a911b425): of the three recorded candidates NONE resolves here and the appended one does, with the consumer at Documents/Github/bwj-development/smartwatchbanden -- whose own 'origin' reads https://github.com/BWJ-Development/smartwatchbanden.git, the live repo #1553 moved this record's 'repo' field to, so it is the checkout this manifest is about and not a same-named tree elsewhere. Before this, check-connectors printed '[SKIP] checkout ... not present on this machine' and exited 0 -- the false absence #1524 named and #1807 repeated, which asserts an absence that is false and suppresses the entire connector block. localCheckout is first-match and additive, so the three earlier candidates stay for the machines they are true on and this is a pure append. THE #1807 NOTE'S RULE IS VINDICATED RATHER THAN WEAKENED, which is worth recording because it reads at first like the opposite: that note anticipated exactly this entry, named it '../../bwjdevelopment/smartwatchbanden', and declined to record it on the ground that recording an unobserved layout is a guessed string in an additive field. A machine now lays the tree out that way -- and the folder is HYPHENATED, 'bwj-development/', so the string that would have been guessed would also have been WRONG, and the check would have gone on skipping this consumer while the register looked like it had been repaired. WHAT THE SKIP WAS HIDING, measured in the same pass with -ConsumerPathOverride rather than left unmeasured as #1831 filed it: all five plugins enabled in the consumer's .claude/settings.json, all registered extensions present (19 + 3 + 3 + 0 + 0) and every machine record on the source version v5.0.0 -- so the block this false absence suppressed was entirely GREEN, and the register was correct about this consumer on every field it records. The finding was never that the data was stale; it was that nobody could see the data. The drift check reads 26 missing agent-defs, 0 identical (dead copies) and 0 drifted, with persona drift informational at 0 of 4 compared -- the same 26 the #1524 note recorded, unchanged. NOT AFFECTED: connectors/xoxowildhearts.json, checked in the same pass -- '../../bwj-development/' holds only smartwatchbanden on this machine, so that connector's [SKIP] is a TRUE absence and its three candidates are deliberately left alone. NOT RE-MEASURED: the shared-script cache drift noted above. STILL OPEN, carried forward from #1807 and not decided here: first-match-wins cannot express two checkouts of the same repo under different parents on one machine. This branch appended one candidate and nothing else. The sentences above keep the names they were WRITTEN with, per #952.
